title: Collision Snapshot Guided Time-Reversed Safety-Critical Scenario Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.06433v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The generation of safety-critical traffic scenarios is essential for training and evaluating autonomous vehicles. Prior approaches typically perturb the trajectories of existing agents in a traffic scenario using simplified adversarial objectives to induce safety-critical interactions, which can limit the plausibility and diversity of the generated scenarios. Although inserting new adversarial vehicles can alleviate this limitation, determining when and where to introduce them in a scenario-specific manner remains challenging. In this work, we introduce \underline{CO}llision \underline{S}napshot guided \underline{T}im\underline{E}-\underline{R}eversed safety-critical scenario generation (COSTER), a framework that leverages learned traffic priors to determine plausible collision times and locations. COSTER first constructs a collision snapshot by inserting a new vehicle in contact with the target vehicle at the identified collision stat

translated_title: 碰撞快照引导的时间反演安全关键场景生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.06433v1 公告类型：cross。摘要：安全关键交通场景的生成对于自动驾驶车辆的训练和评估至关重要。先前的方法通常使用简化的对抗目标来扰动现有交通场景中智能体的轨迹，以诱导安全关键交互，这可能限制所生成场景的合理性和多样性。尽管插入新的对抗车辆可以缓解这一限制，但以场景特定的方式确定何时何地引入这些车辆仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了碰撞快照引导的时间反演安全关键场景生成（COSTER），这是一个利用学习到的交通先验知识来确定合理碰撞时间和位置的框架。COSTER 首先通过在识别出的碰撞状态下插入一辆与目标车辆接触的新车来构建碰撞快照……
tldr: 本文提出COSTER框架，利用学习到的交通先验知识确定合理的碰撞时间和位置，通过时间反演的方式生成更合理、更多样化的安全关键交通场景。
en_tdlr: COSTER leverages learned traffic priors to identify plausible collision times and locations, and generates realistic and diverse safety-critical traffic scenarios through time-reversed generation.
